title:
SPAJ 140C FEEDER
PROTECTION RELAY
text: We kept building on the innovative momentum that we had developed throughout the ‘80s when we introduced the SPAJ 140C feeder protection relay. This new protective relay combined three-phase overcurrent and earth-fault protection and became the market standard solution in applications where control was handled separately. A sister product, SPAM 150C, was also developed for motor protection applications.
funFact: Tech innovation was everywhere at the end of the ‘80s. In 1989, Tim Berners Lee also proposed a system for sharing information using hypertext, the foundation for what would become the World Wide Web.
